opciones.etiqueta: Furskin or with fur parts beyond mere trimming

atributos.ayuda: Garments of leather (42.03), plastics (39.26), rubber (40.15) or furskin (43.03) are excluded from chapters 61 and 62.

atributos.etiqueta: Fabric coated, covered or laminated with plastics or rubber visible to the naked eye
atributos.ayuda: Fabrics of headings 59.03, 59.06 or 59.07 (chapter 61 Note 8, chapter 62 Note 5). A membrane between two fabrics that is not visible, or a quilted padded fabric (58.11), does not count: the outer fabric decides.
